text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking through the plaza—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Shh! I'm currently investigating 
McQueen-san, so please...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A gaze? ...No, perhaps it was just my 
imagination.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. That was a close call...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Until I uncover the secret to 
McQueen-san's strength, I can't let her 
see me!
choice_data_list: Why don't you try asking directly?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No! It's way more thrilling to 
investigate!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? McQueen-san isn't here?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The moment I looked away... Where could 
she have gone?
choice_data_list:
Maybe she went to the lesson room to sing 
her heart out?

She's probably in the cafeteria with her 
head in her hands

They must be training hard on the training 
course!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Understood! Let's head over!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
There are so many lesson rooms. Where 
should I even begin searching—
Ooh... Burn bright...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Singing... I can hear it coming from this 
room!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Carrying our dreams, ah, our~ 
Victorieeees...♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! So crystal clear, yet such a 
powerful singing voice... It's wonderful♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Satono-san?! Um, err, what brings you 
here...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me... was it because I got too 
carried away knowing the room was 
soundproofed...?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks to that, I figured it out! 
McQueen-san's secret.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
S-S-Secret!? Whatever do you mean? J-Just 
now, I was merely singing to refresh 
myself...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...No, I see right through you. 
McQueen-san, you are--"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
By inspiring yourself through song, you 
were able to elevate your performance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? A-Ah... Yes, that is quite 
correct! O-Ohohoho~"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um... please, teach me too. Teach me that 
passionate song from before...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Your heart feels warm...? Does that 
mean... you're pleased with it?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The melody is so passionate that 
before I know it, my heart starts dancing—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to gain a deeper understanding of 
the feelings woven into this poem!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...There are two things I must tell you. 
First, you must not speak a word of what 
happened today to anyone."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And also—my lessons won't be easy, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now then, puff out your chest! With a 
voice that will pierce the heavens... 
ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Blaze up~...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Singing at the top of her lungs, Satono 
Diamond learned a passionate song!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, I couldn't help but imagine it. 
Well then, shall we be on our way?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Pancakes, fruit tarts... Sweet potato cake 
and almond tofu...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Every single one is far too enticing... 
However, exceeding my caloric limit must 
be avoided at all costs! Think... think, 
girl...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
For McQueen-san to be that intensely 
serious just choosing sweets...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...I feel like I've finally understood. 
The secret behind McQueen-san's strength."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Tackling and thinking deeply about even 
the smallest everyday things. Building up 
those daily efforts is what matters 
most...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: McQueen-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa! S-Satono-san...!? Could it be... 
y-you were watching me... !?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! You had such a serious look on your 
face... You were so cool, McQueen-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
T-That makes me... happy, but kinda 
embarrassed too...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to choose my sweets as seriously 
as McQueen-san does!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Umm, let's see... Oh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
“Exotic Sweets Fair”... it says! Let's go 
with that one♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Squid ink cheesecake", "pudding sushi"... 
What on earth is this menu!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Um, Satono-san... Didn't you say you were 
going to choose seriously?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! With all these mysterious sweets... 
don't you think it makes choosing them so 
much fun?♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...! What an incredible spirit of 
inquiry...! You truly face sweets head-on, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I shall take on the challenge as well! 
The "Bizarre Sweets Fair," that is!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san...! Let us blaze a new trail 
in the world of sweets together!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well then... how about that "Nametake Mont 
Blanc"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Satono-san. Would it be all right 
if you took a little more time to think it 
over?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After pondering until they were satisfied, 
the two were able to enjoy some delicious 
sweets!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's a classic for secret special 
training! Let's go take a look...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Um... what in the world are you doing 
right in the middle of the track?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We're playin' toll checkpoint! Wanna pass? 
Make me laugh with a one-liner!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You are troubling the other patrons. 
Please move aside at once, Gold Ship-san.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? What's supposed to be funny about 
that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This is not a quick gag! Jeez, if it's 
come to this, I'll just use brute 
force...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Reeeady, and... ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nowah!? I can't push back... I'm being 
overwhelmed...!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
There he goes... What insane power. He's 
crazy, that guy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um, what were the two of you doing just 
now? It looked like you were wrestling 
sumo...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, what an unexpected showdown. 
Golshi-chan couldn't do a single thing out 
there.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Could the secret to McQueen-san's 
strength lie in her tenacious lower 
body...?!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Golshi-san. Would you please wrestle 
with me in a sumo match as well...? Osu!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You're not ready for this yet. 
Start by mastering a good one-liner first.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: A quick gag...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. My time simply isn't improving.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Did she push herself too hard earlier? 
Gold Ship... I hope she hasn't caused any 
more trouble.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "...Oh? What's that?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: *Clink, clank, clink, clank—*

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Soleus muscles!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Soleus muscle!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"No, no good! You're putting zero hips 
into it! McQueen was way more serious than 
that!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I did no such thing!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: McQueen-san?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Umm, what does that mean— Oh? Golshi-san 
isn't here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through practicing a bizarre gag, Satono 
Diamond inadvertently built up some 
serious muscle!
